goal: An agent iteration whose remaining wall time to the resolved AGENT_ITERATION deadline drops to the configured threshold while an injected progress probe reports no new progress receives exactly one harness-injected checkpoint-commit instruction through the same live-session surface an operator say uses, without the deadline moving.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/invoker_client.py -- the watcher in invoke_iteration_with_client applies an operator say via client.query (_apply_command ~208); the nudge is delivered through this same live-session surface on the watcher cadence

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- InvocationRequest (~247) is the harness->invoker seam whose optional fields (context_observer, recovery_interrupt_event, on_command_applied) are the precedent to mirror; the AGENT_ITERATION ceiling resolution (~3517) is the deadline the threshold keys on; HarnessConfig hosts the new knob and probe seam
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/workflow.py -- the default invoker (~625) forwards request seams into invoke_iteration_with_client; run_task_object threads the new config through

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/deadline_config.py -- read the RESOLVED ceiling via config.deadlines.for_class(DeadlineClass.AGENT_ITERATION), never a DEFAULT_* constant, so operator [deadlines] overrides (phase 14) flow through automatically
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_invoker_client.py -- test_say_injects_user_message_and_emits_applied_event (~207) is the committed fake-client pattern; add the nudge tests beside it
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_harness.py -- scripted invokers and injected clocks are the committed patterns for the threshold/deadline tests
references: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- landability_gate (spec 00061) is the committed pattern for an opaque, git-free consumer closure crossing into core; mirror its discipline for the progress probe
constraints: The progress probe is an injected, git-free, OPTIONAL closure returning an opaque token (equal tokens = no progress since iteration start); core gains zero git awareness, and a None probe (the default) leaves the nudge fully dormant so bare core runs are byte-for-byte unchanged.

The nudge fires at most once per in-flight invocation, only when remaining wall time to the resolved AGENT_ITERATION ceiling <= checkpoint_nudge_seconds AND the probe reports no new progress; it is dispatched via the same client.query surface an operator say uses and emits a distinct telemetry event (harness.checkpoint_nudge).

The nudge must NOT move the deadline: the iteration is still cancelled at the original ceiling after a nudge fires; and it must not fabricate an operator control-command row -- attribution is harness-initiated, distinct from operator steering.

HarnessConfig gains checkpoint_nudge_seconds (float, default 300.0); a value <= 0 disables the nudge, and an unbounded ceiling (AGENT_ITERATION opt-out, resolved None) disables it (no deadline, no remaining time).
The injected text must instruct committing work-in-progress NOW as incremental checkpoint commit(s) on the task branch; exact wording is the implementer's choice.
SDK stays optional (no new top-level SDK imports); flywheel_core.task and flywheel_core.lifecycle purity untouched. Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: No production git probe, no flywheel.toml key, no orchestrator/worker threading -- checkpoint-nudge-wiring owns those.
Container stream-json backend parity is out of scope: the nudge reaches exactly where an operator say reaches today (the live SDK client session).
The per-run wall-clock/token budget ceilings (spec 00042) are NOT the trigger -- only the per-iteration AGENT_ITERATION deadline.
Do not modify or weaken any existing test in test_invoker_client.py or test_harness.py; add new tests only.
edge_cases: Two watcher polls past the threshold -> exactly one injection (the at-most-once assertion must fail a fires-every-poll mutation).
Probe reports progress at threshold time -> zero injections.
Nudge fired, deadline then reached -> the iteration deadline still fires at the ORIGINAL ceiling (fails a nudge-extends-deadline mutation).
threshold >= ceiling -> the nudge is eligible from the first check but still fires at most once.
AGENT_ITERATION opted out (resolved None) -> the nudge never fires.
A raising probe is contained: it never unwinds the iteration, and the nudge is skipped.
